title: Law No. 74/2024 on Climate Actions (Legea nr. 74/2024 privind acțiunile climatice)
citation: Law No. 74 of 11 April 2024, Monitorul Oficial al Republicii Moldova 2024, nr. 209-212, art. 293 (16 May 2024); amended by Law No. 243 of 10 July 2025
evidence: Art. 61 para. (1): "Prezenta lege intră în vigoare peste 18 luni de la data publicării în Monitorul Oficial al Republicii Moldova." Published in Monitorul Oficial Nr. 209-212 of 16 May 2024 (18 months later is 16 November 2025). Law No. 243/2025 Art. VII para. (4) confirms the date: "prevederile ... Legii nr. 74/2024 privind acțiunile climatice se pun în aplicare de la 16 noiembrie 2025" (Monitorul Oficial Nr. 445-447 of 22 August 2025). Opened https://monitorul.gov.md/ro/monitorul/view/pdf/2901 (page 20 of the issue) on 2026-11-03.
notes: The climate framework act (mapped to F2). Its greenhouse gas monitoring, reporting and verification provisions are F3 content: Chapter IV (Art. 49 stationary installations, Art. 50 verification and accreditation, Art. 51 maritime transport, Art. 52 aviation), operator duties in Art. 26 and Annex 1 (activities and thresholds). The Government regulations under it are md-hg-575-2024 (installations and aviation), md-hg-544-2024 (maritime) and md-hg-257-2026 (verifiers); the amendments of Law 243/2025 Art. VI are in md-law-243-2025 (amends this entry). Carbon pricing: Art. 56 "instituie mecanismul financiar de stabilire a prețului pentru emisiile de CO2" but says the mechanism (cap and trade and/or carbon pricing for goods) "se stabilește prin lege", so no emissions trading system is in force; the register carries it as an F7 row. Records stored on 2026-11-03: the Law as first published in Monitorul Oficial 209-212 (adopted, ro) and the Russian text of the same issue (translation, ru), both articles 1 to 61 only: the text layer of Annex 1 is garbled (legacy font encoding) and the three annexes are left out. The stored text is the 2024 text; Law 243/2025 Art. VI changes Art. 8 lit. g, Art. 18, Art. 26, Art. 49 and Annex 1 point 4 (adding the environmental permit alongside the integrated environmental permit), and no consolidation with those changes is stored. legis.md, the Register's consolidated text, was not reachable (Cloudflare challenge), so no consolidation is stored; the records are the text as the gazette printed it. English: no government English translation was found. Looked for on monitorul.gov.md (the issue pages link the Romanian and Russian editions only), legis.md (blocked from the cloud address, Cloudflare challenge) and mediu.gov.md and moldse.md (connection reset from the cloud address).

title: Law No. 243/2025 amending certain normative acts (Lege pentru modificarea unor acte normative; water, waste, environmental impact, industrial emissions and climate actions)
citation: Law No. 243 of 10 July 2025, Monitorul Oficial al Republicii Moldova 2025, nr. 445-447, art. 612 (22 August 2025)
evidence: Art. VII para. (1): "Prezenta lege intră în vigoare peste o lună de la data publicării în Monitorul Oficial al Republicii Moldova." Published in Monitorul Oficial Nr. 445-447 of 22 August 2025 (one month later is 22 September 2025); para. (4) puts the provisions of Law 227/2022 on industrial emissions listed there and Law 74/2024 into application from 16 November 2025. Opened https://monitorul.gov.md/ro/monitorul/view/pdf/3145 (page 30 of the issue) on 2026-11-03.
notes: The register row for Law 74/2024 named this act as the amending law. Its F3 content: Art. V adds the greenhouse gas monitoring plan to the content of the environmental permit under Law 227/2022 on industrial emissions, and Art. VI amends Law 74/2024 (annual list of operators of stationary installations that hold an integrated environmental permit or an environmental permit). Arts. I to IV amend the Water Law, Law 303/2013, Law 86/2014 on environmental impact assessment and Law 209/2016 on waste; they are stored with it as one act. Record stored on 2026-11-03: Romanian only. The Russian text of the same law (Russian issue, pages 23 to 30) was not stored: it holds garbled lines (legacy font encoding) on pages 28 to 30. legis.md, the Register's consolidated text, was not reachable (Cloudflare challenge), so no consolidation is stored; the records are the text as the gazette printed it. English: no government English translation was found. title: Law No. 105-XV/2003 on Consumer Protection (Legea privind protecția consumatorilor)
citation: Law No. 105-XV of 13 March 2003, republished in Monitorul Oficial al Republicii Moldova 2011, nr. 176-181, art. 513 (21 October 2011)
evidence: Art. 34 para. (1) of the republished text: "Prezenta lege intră în vigoare la expirarea a 4 luni de la data publicării." No page opened states the publication date of the original 2003 text, so no commencement date is entered. The republished text is dated 21 October 2011 (Monitorul Oficial Nr. 176-181). Opened https://monitorul.gov.md/ro/monitorul/view/pdf/1734 on 2026-11-03.
notes: The consumer-protection umbrella act named in the brief for environmental claims; the 2011 text bans misleading and aggressive commercial practices (it transposes Directive 2005/29/EC) and never uses the words ecological or green, so environmental claims fall under it only as misleading practices in general. The only dated version the Monitorul Oficial serves is the 2011 republication, so the record is that text (form consolidated) dated 2011-10-21; it holds provisions marked as in force until or from 1 January 2012 and none of the amendments since (Law No. 187 of 22 July 2016 and later, Monitorul Oficial 306-313 of 16 September 2016 and others). The current version is on legis.md, which was not reachable. Records stored on 2026-11-03: Romanian (consolidated) and Russian (translation). English: no government English translation was found.
